featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The ultimate test of wits and teamwork: "The Kon of Kohinoor" at Mystery Rooms Andheri. My team and I took on this "Mission Impossible" with just one hour on the clock, and it was a total blast. The room was packed with intricate puzzles and clever clues that kept us on our toes every single second. It felt like we were in a real-life spy movie, racing against time to steal the diamond.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great time at Mystery Rooms Andheri. We played two games — Abduction and Night in Bhangarh, and both offered very different but equally exciting experiences.

Night in Bhangarh was the highlight for all of us — slightly spooky with dark horror themes, adding an extra thrill. The experience of crawling through spaces, solving clues, and escaping under pressure made it super immersive and fun.

Overall, a perfect mix of challenge, teamwork, and thrill. Great place to visit with friends if you enjoy puzzle-solving and a bit of adventure 👍

featured_reviews.name: Amit Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Escapeverse and chose the "Murder on Eclipse Express" room. Based on the marketing and hype around their use of advanced technology and sensors, I had high expectations. Unfortunately, the experience did not justify the price we paid.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Hrishikesh Doke
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this kids' play zone and found that while the facilities are good, there are some areas that need improvement to enhance the overall experience and safety of children.

1. Overcrowding: The play area was extremely crowded in peak hours, making it difficult for children to enjoy the activities comfortably and safely. Limiting the number of visitors during peak hours or introducing timed slots could help.

2. Insufficient Care Staff: There appeared to be too few staff members supervising the play area. Additional attendants would help monitor children's safety, manage activities better, and assist parents when needed.

3. Parents Inside the Play Area: Many parents were sitting within the play zone itself, creating obstructions and reducing the available space for children to play freely.

Suggestions for Improvement:

- Implement a maximum occupancy limit.
- Increase the number of trained care staff during busy hours.
- Prepare guidelines for kids as well as parents.
- Regularly monitor crowd levels to ensure a safe and enjoyable environment.

With these improvements, the play zone can provide a much better experience for both children and parents.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s birthday at Funkey Monkey Playzone, and we are extremely happy with the entire experience. It was a well-managed and memorable event – truly paisa vasool!

Food:
The food arrangement was excellent – delicious, kid-friendly, and perfectly suited for the occasion. Many of our guests specifically complimented the taste and quality. We were also pleasantly surprised when the team offered us an additional main course dish complimentary, staying well within the agreed budget. A lovely gesture!

Decoration:
The decoration exceeded our expectations. The team went above and beyond by adding a few beautiful elements on their own, which weren’t part of the original plan. The combination of pastel shades looked elegant and festive. We really appreciate the extra effort!

Funkey Monkey Team:
A big shoutout to Samina and Neha, who were incredibly supportive and attentive throughout the planning and during the event. They ensured everything went smoothly and were always available when needed.

Play Area & Tattoo Artist:
The play area was a hit – not just for the kids, but for many of the adults too! The tattoo artist was a great addition, and even grown-ups joined in the fun. It really added to the lively and playful atmosphere.

Suggestions for Improvement:

Despite the couple of minor points, the entire experience was fantastic. Thank you so much to the entire Funkey Monkey team for making our daughter’s birthday so special. We highly recommend this venue for kids' parties and celebrations!

featured_reviews.review_text:
🌸 A Peaceful and Inspiring Visit to Mata Ramabai Ambedkar Smruti Viewing Deck 🌸
My visit to the Mata Ramabai Ambedkar Smruti Viewing Deck was a deeply touching and meaningful experience that filled my heart with respect, calmness, and inspiration 💐. This beautiful place stands as a symbol of strength, sacrifice, and silent support, dedicated to Mata Ramabai Ambedkar, the life partner of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar and an unsung pillar behind his historic journey 🌼.
As I reached the viewing deck, the first thing that caught my attention was the serene and well-planned structure overlooking the vast and calming Arabian Sea 🌊✨. The cool sea breeze, the open sky, and the neatly maintained surroundings created a peaceful environment that instantly relaxed my mind 🍃. The place felt less crowded and more personal, allowing visitors to reflect quietly and deeply 🧘‍♂️.
The memorial beautifully highlights the importance of Mata Ramabai’s sacrifices and resilience 🌺. She stood strong during times of extreme hardship, poverty, and social discrimination, silently supporting Babasaheb’s mission of social justice and equality 💪❤️. While history often celebrates great leaders, this place gently reminds us of the powerful women who stood behind them, holding families together with courage and patience 👩‍🦰✨.
Walking through the deck, I noticed people standing silently, gazing at the sea, lost in thoughts 🌊💭. The soothing sound of waves felt like a conversation between nature and history, telling stories of struggle, faith, and hope 🌈. Informational displays and inscriptions around the area add depth to the experience, helping visitors understand Mata Ramabai’s role in shaping Babasaheb’s life and vision 📖🕯️.
What touched me most was the simplicity and dignity of the memorial 🤍. There is no loud display, no grand celebration—just a quiet space that speaks volumes about humility, strength, and unconditional support 🌸. It inspires us to respect women’s contributions in every walk of life and to acknowledge the silent sacrifices that shape great destinies 🌟.
As I left the Mata Ramabai Ambedkar Smruti Viewing Deck, my heart felt lighter and my thoughts clearer 💖. This visit taught me that true greatness is not always in the spotlight; sometimes, it stands quietly behind, offering strength, love, and unwavering support 🌼. It is a place everyone should visit to experience peace, reflection, and deep respect 🙏✨.

featured_reviews.review_text:
> As the name suggests, it's truly a beauty viewing deck. I decided to visit this place because I wanted to see what the hype was all about by myself. And I'm glad that I visited. 😍

> It is an initiative by Maharashtra Tourism and was inaugurated on 9th February 2022 by Maharashtra Tourism's minister Aditya Thackeray.

> It is built on 26 strong pillars with 26 sitting facilities for over 100 people for them to witness the amazing view of the Arabian Sea. 😍

> I went there around evening and it was pretty crowded and you can spot all kinds of people coming in from families to college students to couples to even people who want to enjoy their own company.

> It's open from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. and is FREE for all. You can simply take a taxi from Dadar station and enjoy the scenic view with your hair flowing with the breeze.

> There are cameras and security guards everywhere that keep walking to check on people and also will ask you to wear a mask if needed.

> It is kept clean irrespective of the fact that thousands of people come in every day to watch the Sea link, highly appreciated. 💯

> The bougainvillea flowers add a touch of beauty to the amazing place. You should definitely visit this place is there is not a single reason why you shouldn't. It's truly beautiful. 😍

The place lives up to the hype being created and is a beautiful breezy place to visit and got the best view of the sea link and also the beach.

There are lovely sitting arrangements made with modern stylized benches and surrounded with plants in elegant looking pots and the pink hue of the Bougainvillea adding to the charm of this place.

The entry looks grand with beautiful engraved artwork and I was absolutely happy to see the place kept so clean with so many people coming in.

There is a security person stationed to ensure there is discipline in the place and overall had a great visit and would be nice if you visit the place early in the morning.

featured_reviews.name: Manas Mirkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this newly opened tourist attraction on a public holiday and could find many citizens enjoying the place.

The viewing deck is near Chaityabhumi, the cremation site of Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar. Keeping high tide in mind, the deck has been built at a height of 10 feet from the sea. Supported by 26 pillars, it covers an area of 10,000 square feet. The deck can accommodate 300 people at a time and has seating arrangements of at least 100 people with 26 benches. In addition, 130 types of trees have been planted to beautify the space.

Ideal time to visit this place would be evening onwards, catching the sunset here would be the ideal scenario. You get a view of the coastline from Worli to Bandra with the iconic (BWSL) sea link bridge 🌉.
The place was clean and buzzing with tourists taking in the view of the sea and catching the breeze or just sitting and chit chatting on the seating spaces provided.

Overall, this is a great addition to the city tourist spots and it's coastline, whenever you visit Dadar/Shivaji park, this place is a must visit.
P. S. You can also relish the famous Ashok vada pav in the next lane, 5 mins from this place.

Special mention: Vinay arranged Rajasthani poshak for us at the Jaisalmer desert camp, which truly made our day and added a special touch to the experience.
⚠️ Cons:
The Ajmer hotel, although beautiful, was located on the highway and a bit far from Ajmer station. Since our internal travel was self-planned, booking autos or local transport was slightly difficult.

Because we had multiple train journeys booked by ourselves, it became a little confusing at times — however the hotel reception helped us book autos, as guided by Vinay, which was supportive.

Jaipur sightseeing was not that great, as the driver was not very familiar with the area.

✅ Overall:
7Adventure is reliable, supportive, and customer-focused. I would definitely recommend them for customized family trips, especially in Rajasthan.
Thank you, 7Adventure, Omkar, and Vinay, for a memorable experience 🙏✨
